blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water employees from its East Zone and Non-East Zone operations joined thousands of volunteers at the International Coastal Cleanup (ICC) 2026 held at Manila Bay’s Dolomite Beach on Sept. 19, 2026. Organized by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources-National Capital Region (DENR-NCR), the annual cleanup mobilized 36,897 volunteers from private companies, nongovernment organizations, academic institutions, and government agencies. According to DENR-NCR, the initiative collected a total of 168,395 kilograms of waste from cleanup sites across Metro Manila.
